g.text: 2. THE EVALUATOR VIEW: ABSTRACT SYNTAX TREE (AST) & MACROS

svg.text: Special Form: Bind Name in Module
WHY THIS MATTERS IN GUIX: HOMOICONICITY & CODE REWRITING
Because every Scheme program is a Cons-Cell Tree, macros (syntax-case) and Guix G-Expressions (#~)
manipulate code using the exact same list operations (car, cdr, cons, map) before compilation:
;; In Guile REPL: Quote (') stops evaluation and returns the raw Cons Cell tree!
scheme@(guile-user)> (pair? code) ;; ⇒ #t (It is a linked cons list!)
scheme@(guile-user)> (caddr code) ;; ⇒ (* x x) (Extract AST body)
;; Rewrite the AST on the fly: replace operator '* with '+ to synthesize a new function:
